# Isaiah Chapter 56 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 12 verses]*

*Justice and righteousness; foreigners and eunuchs included; blind watchmen; greedy dogs*

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** My house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples. This chapter justice and righteousness.
